h: Shabbos Brings Torah and Redemption at the Appointed Moment

p: "I will give your rains in their season" (Vayikra 26:4).
וְכֵן בְּפָרָשַׁת וְהָיָה אִם שָׁמוֹעַ וְגוֹ׳
So too in the parsha "And it shall be, if you hearken, etc." (Devarim 11:13–14):
"I will give the rain of your land in its season, etc.,
and you shall gather in your grain, etc.";
as referring to when they do not do the will of the Omnipresent,
so that their work is done by themselves;
whereas when they do the will of the Omnipresent,
their work is done by others.
that "you will hearken to My commandments"
to plow in the time of plowing, etc.
that he be only to serve his Maker
and to be a laborer of the Torah,
And here, where it is written,
"If you will walk in My statutes, etc.,
we have said that it speaks
of one who merits to be
"I will give your rains in their season";
for this is no benefit to such a person,
since for his part he certainly has enough
and like Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai,
and as is the way of Torah.
that it alludes to words of Torah,
along the lines of what is expounded
with rain, they empty it upon the earth"
"if talmidei chachamim are filled with Torah,
So too, "I will give your rains"
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (דְּבָרִים לב, ב)
along the lines of what it says (Devarim 32:2):
"My teaching shall drop like the rain."
And as for its saying "in their season,"
it is along the lines of what we find
two Shabbosos according to their laws,
at the time of Matan Torah,
when with the utterance "You shall not have"
the yetzer hara was uprooted from their hearts,
and it was said about them (Tehillim 82:6):
the redemption did not come then,
because the yetzer hara immediately returned
one merits to be redeemed immediately,
with no break of even a moment
in which the yetzer hara could
And this is what it says (Yeshayahu 60:22):
"I, Hashem, will hasten it in its time":
that when the time comes, "in its time,"
then "I will hasten it," in a moment,
so that the yetzer hara cannot
And likewise, when one merits on Shabbos
"for their generations," read as their dwelling,
that he makes a dwelling for them
for the upper and lower Shechinah
in the two chambers of the heart,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there
For then he merits the mystery of the servant
and the mystery of the son together as one;
and about him the holy Zohar states
"Beware of Rabbi Meir and his Torah"
And this is what they said, "immediately redeemed,"
So too, "I will give your rains"
Hashem Yisbarach will give the words of Torah,
"in its time I will hasten it."
while in the parsha "And it shall be, if you hearken"
וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (קְדוֹשִׁים, חֵלֶק ג פד, ב)
and in the holy Zohar (Kedoshim, III 84b):
of one heart and one will;
which is not so in Parshas Kedoshim,
where they did not merit this level,
and it is written in the plural.
"Rain for the sake of an individual, etc.:
and that field does not need water,
one who does the will of the Omnipresent,
but not the will of the Omnipresent,
He will still give the rain "in its season."
But here it is written "in their season,"
that even one who has not merited
to be as at Matan Torah,
And so it is regarding words of Torah,
And Shabbos is the time to merit
the unification of the entire Name Havayah,
in the mystery of the servant
and the mystery of the son
